heroHeadline: Ethiopia and Eritrea Break Diplomatic Ties as Red Sea War Fears Rise
heroSubtitle: About 150,000 displaced after Tigrayan forces seized airports in Mekelle, Axum and Shire; Ethiopia accuses Eritrea, Sudan and Egypt, which Sudan and Egypt deny. Independent verification remains limited.
